def factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ema(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    raw = intraday_ret * vol_ratio
    smoothed = raw.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ema"] = smoothed.ffill().fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ema"]
description: Mutation of the volume-regime amplified signal. The elite evidence shows a simpler combination of intraday return and volume ratio smoothed by an EMA achieves higher IC and RankIC without regime amplification. This child abandons the rule-based amplification and replaces the 10-day rolling mean with an exponential moving average, increasing reactiveness and reducing noise. The core price-volume coherence mechanism is preserved: intraday returns weighted by volume intensity capture conviction. The EMA provides a smooth recent-biased signal. This mutation targets improved IC and MI while maintaining ICIR stability.
